description: This PHP class 'RoundCommand' is a console command for managing project rounds in the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It handles processing active projects, changing their status based on campaign progress, and optionally simulating or executing refunds and status updates.

classes.name: RoundCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing project rounds, including ending rounds, updating project statuses, and handling refunds.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's name, description, options, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that processes projects based on campaign status, updates project states, and optionally performs refunds.

methods.name: refundProject
methods.description: Handles executing the refund process for a specific project via a subprocess call.
